date.as_written: samvat 555 vaisāṣaśuklapradipadyāṃ(!) tithau aśuninakṣetre(!) siddhijo gevudavāsarot

notes: No individual person (scribe, patron, or king) is named in the colophon. The phrase 'liti manate jasyo 'rthena bhavatu svabham astu sarvvadā' appears to be a corrupt benediction containing 'yasyārthena bhavatu śubham astu sarvadā' ('for whosever benefit [it may be], may it be auspicious always').
